intro: This errand continues the development of the Royal Apothecary Society's new plague, dispatching a courier from Undercity back to Tarren Mill. Master Apothecary Faranell enriches Lydon's Mudsnout mixture with his own decaying compounds, demanding coastal reagents and alchemical draughts to catalyze the lethal brew.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: A mudsnout composite? Absolutely brilliant! Why didn't I think of that?
Let me contribute my colloid of decay to this devilish brew.

In order to activate the contaminating agents in this mudsnout mixture, Lydon is going to need a strong troll's blood potion, as well as some daggerspine scales and torn fin eyes from the southern coast of Hillsbrad. He'll know what to do once you've gathered him all the reagents. And my, how anxious I am to hear how his experiment goes!

clips.title: Progress
paras: So glad to see you back, friend. I was growing so terribly bored here. Not a single entertaining thing to do besides poison and disease Umpi and reanimate her...over and over and over again.
How went the trip to the Undercity? Were you fortunate enough to slaughter any humans along the way?

clips.title: Completion
paras: The excitement of this experiment has me feeling giddy! You have been such a great help, friend. Together we will spread death and disease to this land!
